instruction:
Single Storey Twin Studio Building IFC And Revit Sheet PDF

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a single-storey building containing two studio units, export the model as result.ifc, and export a two-page Revit sheet PDF as result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.pdf; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 6 IfcSpace entities, 9 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 4 IfcDoor entities, and 6 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token studio at least 2 times, bath at least 2 times, and kitchenette at least 2 times.
7. result.pdf contains exactly 2 pages exported from Revit sheets.
8. The extracted text from result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 GROUND FLOOR PLAN, A201 SOUTH ELEVATION, Studio A, and Studio B.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
